item: The field-check backend is removed: its list, runners, routes, egress lane and strings
summary: R319 release note: the retired Field checks feature (R603) is gone from the app, not only from the screen. Its check list, the code that ran the checks, the three /api/diagnostics/field-checks routes, its entry in the online-hosts list and in SECURITY.md, and its 22 now-unused strings in each of the 12 languages are removed (R654). The one-GET reads of the four thesaurus landing pages (EuroVoc, UNESCO Thesaurus, AGROVOC, IPTC Media Topics) are gone with it. Field data now comes only from the Field data button in Diagnostics.
